about: Hand-curated additions to catalog.json, deep-merged by check_revit_api_compat.py at load time; edit freely, no regeneration needed. 'types'/'instance_members' entries may add: fix (replaces the generic hint), tier ('warning' demotes an error), match (false disables an instance name; true re-enables a name the catalog marks bcl, so deleting a 'match: true' drops its coverage), receiver_exempt (regex searched in the receiver's last identifier, ignoring a trailing .Id, that skips an ambiguous instance name; anchor it with $), avail/obsolete (to assert facts the assemblies cannot express), code (finding code), sources. 'namespaces' match any name under them. Keep every entry backed by a source.

IntegerValue.fix: read ids with `pyrevit.compat.get_elementid_value_func()` (returns Value on 2024+, IntegerValue before)

Value.fix: read ids with `pyrevit.compat.get_elementid_value_func()` (returns Value on 2024+, IntegerValue before)

Autodesk.Revit.DB.DisplayUnitType.fix: use `DB.UnitTypeId` members (ForgeTypeId) on 2021+, branching with `HOST_APP.is_newer_than(2021)` if older Revit matters - see `pyrevit.revit.units`

RevisionNumberingSequenceId.fix: use `pyrevit.revit.db.ensure.revision_has_numbertype()`, which branches on the Revit version

CreateDomain.fix: Revit 2025+ runs on .NET 8+, where AppDomain.CreateDomain throws PlatformNotSupportedException; use AssemblyLoadContext there

Abort.fix: Thread.Abort throws PlatformNotSupportedException on .NET 5+ (Revit 2025+); use a CancellationToken

ReflectionOnlyLoad.fix: reflection-only loading is unsupported on .NET Core (Revit 2025+); use System.Reflection.MetadataLoadContext

ReflectionOnlyLoadFrom.fix: reflection-only loading is unsupported on .NET Core (Revit 2025+); use System.Reflection.MetadataLoadContext

System.Runtime.Serialization.Formatters..fix: BinaryFormatter is obsolete on .NET 8 (Revit 2025/2026) and always throws on .NET 9+ (Revit 2027); serialize with JSON or XML

IntegerValue.fix: for ElementIds read with `pyrevit.compat.get_elementid_value_func()`; WorksetId/ScheduleFieldId keep IntegerValue (suppress with `# compat-ignore: WorksetId`)
IntegerValue.about: ElementId.IntegerValue was removed in 2026; WorksetId and ScheduleFieldId still expose IntegerValue, so receivers that look like those are skipped.

NumberType.fix: for a Revision use `pyrevit.revit.db.ensure.revision_has_numbertype()` (Revision.NumberType is gone in 2023+); RevisionNumberingSequence.NumberType is fine
NumberType.about: Revision.NumberType exists 2021-2022 only; RevisionNumberingSequence.NumberType exists 2022+. The name alone cannot tell them apart, so this is a warning.

ParameterType.about: Also a System.Reflection.ParameterInfo member, but in Revit scripts it is almost always Definition.ParameterType, removed in 2023.

System.Runtime.Remoting.fix: .NET Remoting does not exist on .NET Core (Revit 2025+); use pipes, sockets or HTTP

System.Web.Script.Serialization.fix: JavaScriptSerializer (System.Web.Extensions) does not exist on .NET Core (Revit 2025+); use the Python json module

cpython_unavailable_modules.wpf: the `wpf` module ships with IronPython only; on CPython load XAML via System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader, or run the script on IronPython (drop `#! python3`)
